verdict.rationale: Docs include code snippets (e.g. ToolLoopAgent example) and a publicly available OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) plus an unauthenticated models endpoint, which could underpin interactive tooling, but there is no evidence of an actual interactive API console/playground where examples can be run live from the docs. Missing for 10: a documented try-it-now console, in-browser code execution, or Swagger/Redoc-style interactive explorer confirmed by first-party docs or hands-on reports.
